//: Publisher identity for your own builds. Copy to build.config.json (gitignored) and fill in.
Everything here is optional. Without it the browsers assign a development id,
which is what you want while working locally or running from source.
chromeKey  the 'key' manifest property, which pins the Chrome extension id.
Take it from the .pem you generate when you first pack the extension,
or from the Chrome Web Store listing once published.
geckoId    the AMO add-on id, conventionally an email-shaped string on a domain
oauth2     only needed if you add a Google OAuth flow. The upstream project ships
this key but does not read it: sign-in goes through
